data.name: Waldzweisamkeit
data.detailed_description:
An eerie logic-puzzle adventure set in an endless forest.

Step into an terrifying woodland, discover a lonely manor and obey it's mysterious rules in order to leave this never-ending nightmare. Each room challenges you with choices — follow the logic, interpret the clues, and uncover the pattern. 

Think you can outsmart the manor? Prove it — add to your wishlist today.

Features

  • Atmospheric Puzzle Gameplay – Solve interconnected riddles where rules change as you progress.

  • Evolving Rule System – New rules are added each round, creating increasingly complex puzzles.

  • Dynamic World – Explore a forest and manor that subtly shift between runs, keeping you guessing.

  • Immersive Tension – Unsettling, horror-tinged atmosphere without cheap jump scares.

  • Minimal UI – Stay focused on the environment and clues.

  • Adjustable Settings – Fine-tune graphics, controls, and brightness for your perfect experience.

  • Multiple Languages – Playable in multiple languages (English, German, Japanese. Thai).

Gameplay

In Waldzweisamkeit, gameplay centers on exploring an abandoned manor and uncovering objects scattered across its rooms. Each round introduces a set of rules that determine which room is “safe.” Your task is to choose the room that follows all active rules — and survive.

Choose wrong, and the world resets: no progress, no new rules, just another chance to try again. With every run, the rooms are dynamically rearranged, meaning the correct solution is never in the same place twice.

Progress comes only through understanding — truly learning the rules, recognizing their logic, and applying them under changing conditions. Waldzweisamkeit challenges your perception, memory, and reasoning until you finally master the manor’s strange design.

Playtime

30-60 min

Requirements

  • Sound needs to be enabled
